boundary.startingEvent: A sighted hero with !autopickup makes an ordinary one-square move onto a shopless ROOM or CORR square holding two to four source-nameable objects, at least one rendered name containing non-ASCII bytes.
boundary.endingEvent: Space dismisses the Things-that-are-here hybrid TTY window, its covered region is repaired, and the game reaches the next command boundary with the pile and command state intact.
boundary.validInputs: Shopless ordinary ROOM/CORR piles of two to four objects; short two-, three-, and four-byte text; a space-bearing name at or beyond CO bytes; a PL_PSIZ truncation ending inside a multibyte sequence; menu_overlay enabled or disabled; and a pending TTY topline before look_here displays WIN_MESSAGE.
boundary.observables: Exact PRNG calls, byte-derived maxcol/offx and recursive split rows, complete cells/attributes/cursors, More input waits, snapshot restoration, pile identity and dknown state, run/multi state, unread input, and persisted state through the next prompt.
boundary.exclusions: Shops, unpaid objects, pricequotes, blindness, cockatrice handling, swallowed heroes, pile-limit count output, one-object messages, decorated headers, paging, selectable menus, and multibyte paths outside this pile window.
